title: MLibrary
body:
**MLibrary** is a lightweight, modern, and fully configurable library plugin for [MCommander](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mcommander).
The plugin is designed with an emphasis on **clean code**, **clarity**, **Folia compatibility**, and **easy extensibility**.

It is ideal for all type of servers that want essential commands in one place.

---

## ✨ Key Features

✅ Folia-safe

🧼 Clean, readable, and easily extendable codebase

⚙️ Contains all needed libraries for MCommander plugin
